claims.claim: Current branch HEAD and tree are pinned above.
The v2 bundle pins 1403e108... and contains a 19-task DAG with task receipts. They are not silently promoted to current-HEAD receipts.
Spatial v1 raw results contain 144 successful rows across four problems, twelve arms and three requested tolerances, with three repetitions.
All 520 matched-error entries are DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; no matched cross-solver speedup is admitted.
vigilode and vigilode-banded are explicitly grid-clipped continuity arms. Endpoint-only dense-output arms exist in source but are absent from spatial v1.

Four references compare RADAU5 and CVODE at rtol=1e-12 on a 101-point grid. Observed discrepancies are approximately 1.08e-10 to 1.49e-10 against a 1e-8 dispute threshold. This is not a rigorous bound.
error_common and error_wrms_own are distinct metrics and must not be interchanged.
The spatial allocation window includes setup, integration, output-state storage and teardown; it does not isolate the hot loop.
A SHA-256 source manifest, binary hash and corpus hash are present, but build context is dirty on predecessor base 1403e... and dirty source was explicitly allowed.
No GitHub commit status contexts or workflow runs were returned for current HEAD. Empty status is not PASS.
README maintains HOLD_NOT_RELEASE_QUALIFIED. ProductionSolver remains scoped to smooth forward identity-mass IVPs with endpoint observations; continuous validated enclosures remain active research.
DriveState is live dispatcher; HybridRouteAutomaton is a discrete verification model.
AUTH receipts document restricted certificate authority; generic callbacks, general nonnormal operators and higher-dimensional observer certificates remain limited or EstimateOnly.

findings.observed: 520/520 records are DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY because both curves do not bracket the requested common error targets.
findings.impact: No matched achieved-error cross-solver speedup is established.
findings.smallest_correction: Create a new endpoint-only corpus with preregistered targets and admit only bracketed MATCHED rows.

findings.observed: Current spatial arms are grid-clipped and land a solver step at each output time; endpoint-only dense-output arms exist but are not included.
findings.impact: Grid clipping confounds comparison with freely stepping external solvers.
findings.smallest_correction: Use vigilode-dense and vigilode-banded-dense as primary baselines; keep clipped arms as controls.

findings.observed: Only one RADAU5/CVODE tolerance level is used on 101 sample points.
findings.impact: Empirical point agreement only; no continuous-time bound and no robust uncertainty scale near reported candidate error.
findings.smallest_correction: Preregister a decreasing reference ladder, refinement test and uncertainty budget.

findings.observed: Spatial allocator count is whole-run, including setup, integration, final output states and teardown.
findings.impact: This does not establish hot-loop zero allocations.
findings.smallest_correction: Use calibrated full-step/route allocation tests with setup outside the measured region.

findings.impact: Not a clean build from current committed HEAD.
findings.smallest_correction: Rebuild and re-run authoritative campaign on exact clean current HEAD.
